name: Sheet Contacts through Dropcontact to Lemlist
description: Read a sheet contact batch, enrich it with French company information, wait 45 seconds and create every returned contact as a Lemlist campaign lead.
requirements: Google Sheets Connection with read access to the configured range
Dropcontact API Connection and a contact range containing at most 250 data rows
Lemlist API Connection with Provider API Request permission and permission to create campaign leads/contacts/companies
Execution deployment retaining the 45-second wait and complete data within the Code host budget
